dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Are we back up here again? Ah wait, Paimon's confused! Are we up here or down there!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, good thing we didn't fall, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Yes we did, we just fell upwards.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not helping, Nahida! Ugh, Paimon has no clue what's going on anymore!
